stories.title: Ukrainian and Russian forces clash inside a Soviet gas pipeline in Kharkiv
stories.summary: For about seven months Ukrainian troops and Russian forces have been living and fighting inside an old Soviet gas pipeline in the Kharkiv region. The pipe is just over a metre in diameter, allowing only crawling, and it provides relative protection from the drones that now dominate the skies above the front line. The underground fighting has made forward advances difficult for both sides.
stories.why: It shows how both armies are moving combat underground to mitigate the impact of pervasive drone warfare.
stories.change: New high-signal event entered the brief.

stories.title: US Secretary of State Rubio says no evidence of coordinated tech outages
stories.summary: In a press briefing, Secretary of State Marco Rubio told reporters there is “zero evidence” that the recent week’s tech disruptions—including a major Microsoft outage, a glitch that grounded U.S. flights, and problems affecting banks, Apple and the NSA—are linked. He said the incidents are not inter‑related and emphasized that the United States is not under a systemic attack. Cyber‑security experts cited in the briefing also said no link has been found, attributing many issues to aging infrastructure updates.
stories.why: The clarification aims to reduce public anxiety and prevent misinterpretation of unrelated technical failures as a coordinated cyber threat.

stories.title: Goldman Sachs projects RBI to raise policy rate by 75 bps in Q2 2027
stories.summary: Goldman Sachs forecasts that the Reserve Bank of India will increase its policy interest rate by 75 basis points in the second quarter of 2027. The bank expects headline inflation to stay above 6 % through early 2027 before easing, while GDP growth is projected to slow to about 7.2 % that year. It attributes the outlook to strong domestic demand and an emerging investment cycle that could keep economic activity robust.
stories.why: RBI action or currency-market developments can affect rupee volatility, hedging costs and foreign-exchange conditions for businesses and investors.

stories.title: Prestige Group buys 50 pc stake in Advent Convention and Hotels International for Rs 500 cr
stories.summary: Prestige Estates Projects Ltd has successfully acquired a 50% stake in Advent Convention and Hotels International for an estimated Rs 500 crore. The total project valuation is forecasted at approximately Rs 4,500 crore, marking a significant expansion for Prestige in the Mumbai real estate market.

stories.title: Kuwait says it repelled Iranian drone attack on US‑hosted airbase
stories.summary: Kuwait condemned an overnight drone attack that Iran said targeted the Ali Al Salem airbase, which hosts U.S. forces. Kuwaiti authorities reported the drones were repelled and no damage occurred, marking the first Iranian strike on Kuwaiti territory in more than two months. The incident followed U.S. warplane strikes on an Iranian missile launch site on Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz.
stories.why: It signals a further escalation in Iran‑U.S. tensions and raises regional security concerns.

stories.title: India on track to hit $1 trillion exports target in FY27, says commerce secretary
stories.summary: India’s exports rose 16.6% in the first half of the current fiscal year. The previous fiscal year recorded a historic $863 billion in exports. Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal said the country remains on schedule to reach a $1 trillion export target by FY 2026‑27, even as global trade uncertainties persist.
stories.why: Trade developments can affect currencies, business costs, market access and the external balance of the economies involved.

stories.title: India, US near completion of trade deal talks, signing depends on US tariff rules and Section 301 resolution
stories.summary: Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal said the legal texts of the India‑US trade deal are almost finalised, indicating negotiations are close to completion. The agreement can be signed only after the United States puts in place new tariff rules and resolves the ongoing Section 301 investigations. Both governments have expressed a desire to conclude the pact quickly to strengthen their economic partnership.
